build.name: Build system
build.description: Build rules, compiler/linker options, SDK/toolchain setup, generated library artifacts and packaging. CI runner/test orchestration belongs to ci; build edits that only support another feature follow that feature.

bootstrap.name: Bootstrap
bootstrap.description: Bootstrap control-plane discovery, unique IDs, root/peer rendezvous, sockets/UDS and rank metadata exchange. Collective/P2P data-plane transport belongs to transport or network.

device-topology.name: Device detection and path building
device-topology.description: Discover devices, NICs and physical links, parse topology data, and compute reachability and communication paths. Logical ring/tree/channel graph construction belongs to graph-search.

graph-search.name: Topology graph search
graph-search.description: Construct and search logical ring, tree and channel graphs over the detected topology, including graph rank ordering and connection. Physical topology/path discovery belongs to device-topology; algorithm cost models belong to tuning.

transport.name: Transport build and connect
transport.description: Generic transport selection and rank connection management, including P2P/SHM setup, resources and cleanup. Network-specific backend setup, transfers and proxy progress belong to network.

tuning.name: Built-in collective tuning
tuning.description: Built-in bandwidth/latency models, algorithm/protocol cost comparison and default model-based selection. Symmetric-specific kernel/CE choices and thresholds belong to symmetric; external tuner ABI/callbacks belong to tuner-plugin.

communicator.name: Communicator lifecycle
communicator.description: Communicator creation, initialization state, split/shrink, abort/revoke, suspend/resume and destruction. Feature-specific setup or fields in shared initialization/communicator files follow the owning feature.

memory.name: Memory management
memory.description: General host/device allocation, registration, mapping, import/export, pools, reference ownership and release. Device communicator/window/LSA API semantics belong to device-api.

enqueue.name: Runtime kernel planning and enqueue
enqueue.description: Shared host-side task queues, work batches, launch sequencing, streams, groups and graph capture/replay. Rank scheduling belongs to scheduling, CU/CE placement to dispatch, and symmetric-specific planning to symmetric.

dispatch.name: CU/CE hardware dispatch
dispatch.description: CU/CE hardware resource masks, affinity and driver launch policies, including blocks per CU and batches per CE. Device-side function tables, IDs and specialization matching belong to kernels; built-in algorithm/protocol choice to tuning; symmetric kernel/CE path choice to symmetric.

network.name: Network transport, plugin and proxy
network.description: Collective/P2P network data transport, network backends, net-plugin ABI/loading, connection resources and network proxy progress. Bootstrap rendezvous belongs to bootstrap; GIN-specific networking belongs to gin.

kernels.name: Native operations and device kernels
kernels.description: Built-in collective/P2P device kernels, communication primitives and reductions, including device-side function-table routing, function IDs and specialization matching such as SendRecv. Host rank scheduling belongs to scheduling; CU/CE policies to dispatch; extension, symmetric-memory and CE kernels keep their own modules.

scheduling.name: AlltoAll and P2P scheduling
scheduling.description: Host-side AlltoAll/P2P rank pairing, send/receive rounds, ordering and rank-level batching. Device-side SendRecv execution belongs to kernels, CE/DMA transfer partitioning to copy-engine, and symmetric task planning to symmetric.

kernel-plugin.name: Kernel plugin and extension kernels
kernel-plugin.description: Extension-kernel ABI, discovery/loading, eligibility callbacks, workspace/lifecycle integration and plugin-provided execution. Native built-in device implementations belong to kernels.

tuner-plugin.name: Tuner plugin
tuner-plugin.description: External tuner ABI, loading/lifecycle, callbacks and integration of plugin-provided algorithm/protocol decisions. Built-in cost models and default tuning policy belong to tuning.

profiler.name: Profiler and plugin
profiler.description: Profiling event definitions, timing/trace instrumentation, profiler-plugin ABI/callbacks and inspector integration. Hang monitoring and failure diagnostics belong to ras.

symmetric.name: Symmetric-memory collectives
symmetric.description: Symmetric-memory collective kernels, eligibility, task planning, kernel/CE path selection, local thresholds and synchronization. Window/LSA API semantics belong to device-api; independent CE/DMA transfer execution belongs to copy-engine.

copy-engine.name: Copy-engine operations
copy-engine.description: Collective/P2P execution through CE/DMA: batch submission, transfer partitioning, queues, streams and completion synchronization, including OKI and P2P DMA. Symmetric collective kernel/CE path selection and its thresholds belong to symmetric.

ras.name: RAS and hang diagnostics
ras.description: Health/error reporting, hang detection, communicator/work dumps and offline failure diagnosis. Diagnostic control traffic stays with ras; performance profiling events belong to profiler.

device-api.name: Device API and LSA
device-api.description: Public device communicator, window and LSA APIs, their host/device implementation, pointer access, barriers and local bulk operations. GIN networking APIs belong to gin and CU/CE dispatch configuration to dispatch.

gin.name: GIN
gin.description: Device-initiated networking APIs, GIN connections/progress, registration, plugins and GIN-specific RDMA backends. Shared host-driven network transport belongs to network; generic device communicator/window/LSA semantics belong to device-api.

workflow.name: Contribution and review workflows
workflow.description: Contribution and review/merge policy, issue/PR templates, reviewer assignment/approval, commit validation and squash-message automation, including supporting Actions wiring. Normal test execution and pass/fail criteria belong to ci.

ci.name: Open-source test workflows
ci.description: Normal CI build/test selection, matrices, runners/environments, execution, result reporting and test pass/fail aggregation. Contribution/review policy belongs to workflow; compiler/build definitions and packaging belong to build.

other.name: Other changes
other.description: Functionality outside the catalog, general utilities without a dedicated module, or changes that remain ambiguous after reading the complete diff. Explain the uncovered behavior or uncertainty; a shared or unlisted file alone is not a reason to use other.
